core_concept: A severe, highly professional B2B lead generation operations tool. Rejects rounded corners and playful gradients in favor of authoritative, data-dense editorial layouts inspired by Bloomberg Terminal and high-end technical manuals.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The 'Control Room' Grid - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or strict 12-column layouts for dense data tables.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid #DCDCCF for internal dividers. Use 2px or 3px solid #0A0A0A for major structural section headers to emulate print editorial design.

components.buttons: Flat, rounded-none. Primary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white hover:bg-neutral-800. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#0A0A0A] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-black/5.
components.inputs: rounded-none, border-b-2 border-transparent bg-neutral-100 hover:bg-neutral-200 focus:bg-white focus:border-b-2 focus:border-[#0A0A0A] focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm. Completely reject standard rounded generic inputs.
components.tables: Dense. 36px-48px row height. font-mono for all numbers. Right-align all numeric columns. border-y border-[#DCDCCF]. No vertical borders inside tables to improve scanning (Bloomberg style).
components.cards: No shadow whatsoever. Background white. 1px border border-[#DCDCCF]. Sharp corners.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Strictly functional. Background color shifts for table rows (hover:bg-neutral-50). No bouncing, no scaling.

accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, table rows, and export triggers MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'rfp-submit-button', 'input-client-id').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA compliance. Muted text must be #666666 or darker on #F4F4F0 background.

specific_page_instructions.app_structure: Single-page application containing a Dashboard Summary view and a main RFP Form Tracker view. Use a heavy typographic header (H1 Cormorant Garamond) as the navigation anchor.
specific_page_instructions.dashboard_summary: Top area: F-pattern KPIs (Total RFPs, Avg Conversion, Volume Delivered) with massive font-mono numbers. Charts: Recharts (Line/Bar/Donut) styled minimally with the strict black/grey/red color palette.
rfp_form_sections: Section 1: RFP Discovery - Grid layout for inputs (Client ID, Campaign, Target Geo, etc.). Label text should be font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-widest.
Section 2: Data Universe Estimation - Visually distinct. A large block with a stark black background and white font-mono text displaying the auto-computed number.
Section 3: Computation of Leads Qty - A dense data table. Rows for MQL types. Columns for CPC, Lead Counts, CPL, Total Cost. Total Cost and CPL must auto-calculate aggressively on input blur/change.
Section 4: RFP Status - Minimalist toggles (Converted Y/N) and strict date inputs.
specific_page_instructions.export_functionality: Prominent 'Export CSV' and 'Export Excel' buttons grouped together. Style them technically (e.g., '[ EXPORT .CSV ]' button text in mono font).
